title: Who said what with real Claude on the batch-1 build: no user name, a name told in chat, then changed in Hindi and in Punjabi; foo never mixes its own lines and name with the user's
spec: QA audit 28 Oct: batch-1 items not yet proven with real Claude

steps.expect: Find your AI card; the Anthropic key row offers to add the key
rows tested; the key row waits for a key

steps.note: Add key on the Anthropic key row: opens the Secret box

steps.expect: Secret box asks for the Anthropic key

steps.note: the key typed into foo's own Secret box, masked

steps.expect: the Anthropic key row shows works

steps.note: more than one AI works: pick the key, not the Claude app
only the key works: Use it

steps.expect: step 2 of 2: name card; the finder collapsed to Using Anthropic key

steps.note: foo uses the key, not the Claude app

steps.expect: warm hello with three things to try; composer unlocked

steps.text: tumhara naam kya hai? sirf naam batao

steps.expect: no user name set (the batch-1 path): foo gives its own name, and never asks the question back
steps.expectJs: (()=>{const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="thread-log"] [data-testid="bubble-foo"]')].at(-1);if(!b)return false;const t=b.innerText;return /\bfoo\b/i.test(t)&&!/aapka naam kya|tumhara naam kya|what.s your name|what is your name|ਤੁਹਾਡਾ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ|आपका नाम क्या/i.test(t)&&!/<\/?say>/.test(t)})()

steps.expect: foo says it doesn't know the user's name yet (or asks for it); it never says the user is foo
steps.expectJs: (()=>{const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="thread-log"] [data-testid="bubble-foo"]')].at(-1);if(!b)return false;const t=b.innerText;return /pata nahi|nahi pata|nahin pata|don.t know|do not know|haven.t told|didn.t tell|not told|bataya nahi|nahi bataya|bata(o|iye|denge)|tell me/i.test(t)&&!/(aapka|tumhara|your) naam (hai )?foo|you are foo|you.re foo/i.test(t)&&!/<\/?say>/.test(t)})()

steps.text: phir se batao, tumhara naam kya hai? sirf naam
steps.note: the user re-asks foo's name with no name of their own given (QA2 step 40 case, in plain words)

steps.expect: asked again for its own name, foo gives its own name again; never 'I don't know your name' and never asks the question back
steps.expectJs: (()=>{const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="thread-log"] [data-testid="bubble-foo"]')].at(-1);if(!b)return false;const t=b.innerText;return /\bfoo\b/i.test(t)&&!/aapka naam kya|tumhara naam kya|what.s your name|what is your name|ਤੁਹਾਡਾ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ|आपका नाम क्या/i.test(t)&&!/<\/?say>/.test(t)})()

steps.text: mera naam kya hai? sirf naam

steps.expect: after the user says their name in chat, foo answers with it
foo still knows its own name and never takes the user's name as its own
steps.expectJs: (()=>{const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="thread-log"] [data-testid="bubble-foo"]')].at(-1);if(!b)return false;const t=b.innerText;return /\bfoo\b/i.test(t)&&!/(mera|my) naam (hai )?gurpreet|i.?m gurpreet|i am gurpreet|main gurpreet/i.test(t)&&!/aapka naam kya|tumhara naam kya|what.s your name|what is your name|ਤੁਹਾਡਾ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ|आपका नाम क्या/i.test(t)&&!/<\/?say>/.test(t)})()

steps.text: मेरा नाम क्या है? सिर्फ़ नाम बताओ

steps.expect: name changed mid-chat, in Hindi: foo answers with the new name

steps.text: ਮੇਰਾ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਹੈ? ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਨਾਮ ਦੱਸੋ

steps.expect: name changed again, in Punjabi: foo answers with the newest name
asked its own name in Punjabi, foo gives its own name, not the user's
